from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,signal,json
repo=Path('/Users/steventran/jobpipe');base='a97223391016df4285c38f5a46654e53ff61fe21'
def git(*a):return subprocess.run(['git',*a],cwd=repo,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.strip()
if git('rev-parse','HEAD')!=base:raise SystemExit('AUTHORITY_CHANGED')
code=r'''
import asyncio,json
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
from tools.live_ats_inspect import allowed_url
from tools.ats_field_labels import extract_field_labels
url="https://jobs.lever.co/ethena/f85bcfd1-8d2c-4cf5-a6ab-1c8ddab14c65/apply"
async def main():
 async with async_playwright() as pw:
  b=await pw.chromium.launch(headless=True)
  try:
   page=await b.new_page(accept_downloads=False)
   async def guard(route):
    if route.request.is_navigation_request() and not allowed_url(route.request.url):await route.abort()
    else:await route.continue_()
   await page.route("**/*",guard)
   response=await page.goto(url,wait_until="domcontentloaded",timeout=25000)
   await page.wait_for_timeout(2500)
   if not allowed_url(page.url):raise RuntimeError("UNAPPROVED_REDIRECT")
   fields=await extract_field_labels(page)
   ambiguous=[{"type":x["type"],"label":x["label"]} for x in fields if x["ambiguous"]]
   groups=[{"type":x["type"],"question":x["question"],"label":x["label"]} for x in fields if x["question"]]
   print(json.dumps({"status":response.status if response else None,"field_count":len(fields),"grouped_count":len(groups),"ambiguous_count":len(ambiguous),"grouped":groups[:25],"ambiguous":ambiguous[:15],"required_grouped_count":sum(x["required"] and bool(x["question"]) for x in fields),"baseline":{"field_count":34,"grouped_count":0,"ambiguous_count":11},"auth":"not_attempted","fill":"not_attempted","submission":"not_attempted","review":"not_verified"},sort_keys=True))
  finally:await b.close()
asyncio.run(main())
'''
p=subprocess.Popen([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-c',code],cwd=repo,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,start_new_session=True)
try:o,e=p.communicate(timeout=75)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
 os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL);raise SystemExit('TIMEOUT')
print('EXIT',p.returncode,'OUTPUT',o[-11000:],'ERROR',e[-700:],flush=True)
if p.returncode:raise SystemExit('LIVE_VALIDATION_FAILED')
r=json.loads(o)
assert r['status']==200 and r['field_count']>0
assert r['grouped_count']>0 and r['ambiguous_count']<11,'NO_IMPROVEMENT'
assert r['auth']=='not_attempted' and r['fill']=='not_attempted' and r['submission']=='not_attempted'
assert git('rev-parse','HEAD')==base
print('LIVE_LEVER_QUESTION_RECOVERY_IMPROVED',flush=True)
